article.title: 信和聖誕燈飾徵集照片，入選故事可化為AI動畫
article.summary: 信和集團在尖沙咀中心及帝國中心推出Party with DJ Santa，並邀請公眾提交照片及故事。
highlights: 入選作品可製成AI動畫，融入海旁外牆燈光展示。
場地把麼地里及外牆燈飾串連為拍照路線；案例報道來自信和贊助內容。
article.why: 商場活動可把參與者的內容與實體場景連結，並在徵集時清楚說明如何選用和展示照片。
article.next_step: 規劃同類活動時，先列照片授權、入選通知、製作修改及展示期間的處理步驟。
article.detail: 場地方的官方頁面列出燈光匯演、麼地里星光走廊及帝國中心外牆三個拍照點，並說明公眾可提交照片及背後的故事。Marketing-Interactive的信和贊助文章介紹了把入選照片轉為動畫的構想。此例可供團隊檢查徵集、製作和現場觀賞之間的流程，以及每個環節應如何向參與者交代。
article.title_en: Sino invites photo submissions for AI animations in its Christmas lights
article.summary_en: Sino Group launched Party with DJ Santa at Tsim Sha Tsui Centre and Empire Centre and invited the public to submit photos and stories.
highlights_en: Selected entries may become AI animations in the harbourfront display.
The venue links Mody Lane and façade displays into a photo route. The case article is Sino-sponsored content.
article.why_en: Mall teams can connect visitor contributions with a physical setting and explain how photos will be selected and displayed.
article.next_step_en: Define photo permissions, selection notices, revision handling and display-period procedures for a similar campaign.
article.detail_en: The venue's official page lists the light show, Mody Lane corridor and Empire Centre façade as three photo spots and invites photos with their stories. Sino's sponsored Marketing-Interactive article describes turning selected submissions into animations. Teams can examine how submission, production and the visit connect and what participants need to know at each stage.
